message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build release zip

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
  push:
   branches:
    - trunk

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build release zip
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Cache node_modules
        id: cache-node-modules
        uses: actions/cache@d4323d4df104b026a6aa633fdb11d772146be0bf # v4.2.2
        env:
          cache-name: cache-node-modules
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Setup node version and npm cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@cdca7365b2dadb8aad0a33bc7601856ffabcc48e # v4.3.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        if: steps.cache-node-modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm install

      - name: Build plugin
        run: npm run build

      - name: Generate ZIP file
        uses: 10up/action-wordpress-plugin-build-zip@b9e621e1261ccf51592b6f3943e4dc4518fca0d1 # v1.0.2",
  "rationale": "The build job has no explicit timeout (defaults to 360 minutes), so a hung or runaway build can consume the full runner budget. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) reports reduced runaway consumption and improved feedback from explicit job timeouts, and the experiment records show adding timeout-minutes to a job preserves all steps while cutting elapsed time. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 gives operational headroom above a normal plugin build while bounding runaway consumption. All existing steps, coverage, permissions, and actions are preserved unchanged; no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}

      - name: Checkout

        uses: actions/cache@d4323d4df104b026a6aa633fdb11d772146be0bf # v4.2.2
        env:
          cache-name: cache-node-modules
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Setup node version and npm cache
        uses: actions/setup-node@cdca7365b2dadb8aad0a33bc7601856ffabcc48e # v4.3.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        if: steps.cache-node-modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm install

      - name: Build plugin
        run: npm run build

      - name: Generate ZIP file
        uses: 10up/action-wordpress-plugin-build-zip@b9e621e1261ccf51592b6f3943e4dc4518fca0d1 # v1.0.2
